te: Odoacer, the first barbarian King of Italy after the fall of the Western Roman Empire, is slain by Theoderic the Great,…
dz: 奥多亚塞，西罗马帝国灭亡后意大利第一位野蛮人国王，被东哥特国王狄奥多里克大帝杀死，当时两位国王正在共进宴会。
de: Odoacer, the first barbarian King of Italy after the fall of the Western Roman Empire, is slain by Theoderic the Great, king of the Ostrogoths, while the two kings were feasting together.
